title: A novel behavioral paradigm for odor-induced voluntary urination in mice.
authors: Yin, Lingxuan; Pang, Shutong; Li, Xianping; Deng, Guoxian; Shao, Wei; Xia, Xiaowen; Zhu, He; Yan, Junan; Yao, Jiwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小鼠气味诱导的自主排尿行为范式及脑区激活，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: Voluntary urination-the conscious control over urine release based on internal and external cues-is essential for social functioning and physiological homeostasis, yet the neural mechanisms underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. Effective mechanistic dissection requires genetically tractable models with robust naturalistic behaviors. However, C57BL/6J mice, despite their rich genetic toolkit, exhibit weak scent-marking unless subjected to prolonged social isolation, whereas BALB/c mice display robust marking but lack genetic accessibility. To bridge this gap, we employed F1 hybrid males (C57BL/6J x BALB/c) to combine these complementary strengths and established a 10-minute odor-driven paradigm in which both group-housed and socially isolated F1 males exhibited robust scent-marking toward estrous female urine. To facilitate efficient and accurate analysis of urine deposition from this behavioral paradigm, we trained a YOLOv8-based deep learning model for automated quantification, achieving high accuracy. Furthermore, whole-brain c-Fos mapping revealed significant activation in the prefrontal cortex, brainstem, and other key regions implicated in regulating this voluntary voiding behavior. Thus, our study establishes a novel behavioral paradigm for odor-induced voluntary urination, providing a genetically accessible model system to dissect the neural circuits governing physiological voiding and neurogenic lower urinary tract dysfunction.
abstract_zh: 自主排尿——基于内外线索对尿液释放的有意识控制——对于社会功能和生理稳态至关重要，然而这一行为背后的神经机制仍知之甚少。有效的机制解析需要具有遗传可操作性且具备稳健自然行为的模型。然而，C57BL/6J小鼠尽管拥有丰富的遗传工具，除非经历长期社会隔离，否则表现出较弱的气味标记行为，而BALB/c小鼠则表现出稳健的标记行为但缺乏遗传可及性。为弥合这一差距，我们采用F1杂交雄性（C57BL/6J x BALB/c）以结合这些互补优势，并建立了一个10分钟气味驱动范式，在该范式中，群居和社会隔离的F1雄性均对发情期雌性尿液表现出稳健的气味标记。为促进该行为范式中尿液沉积的高效准确分析，我们训练了一个基于YOLOv8的深度学习模型进行自动量化，实现了高精度。此外，全脑c-Fos图谱揭示前额叶皮层、脑干及其他关键区域在调节这一自主排尿行为中的显著激活。因此，我们的研究建立了一种气味诱导自主排尿的新行为范式，提供了一个遗传可访问的模型系统，以解析调控生理性排尿和神经源性下尿路功能障碍的神经回路。
